FC Series (Drawn Cup Roller Clutch)

A metric-spec drawn cup roller clutch in the IKO/NTN line. It has a compact structure with needle rollers and sprags fitted inside a thin drawn (stamped) outer ring, and is press-fitted directly into the bearing bore seat without a housing.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.
